principle.name: CONTACT CAN REASSIGN THE LEADING END
principle.pocket_rule: PIN THE FRONT TIP, SLIDE THE BODY AND HANDS THROUGH THE STAFF, THEN LET THE REAR END BECOME THE RECOVERY LEADER.
principle.fresh_interpretation: The strike begins with rear-weighted clearance and a body-first entry. The front staff tip earns a distinct precontact and contact. While the tip is pinned, the pelvis and hands keep moving so the shaft becomes a temporary relationship axis rather than a rigid prop. Release does not reverse the attack: the former rear end sweeps low as the former front tip rebounds high, producing a visible end-role reassignment before a wide catch and forward-debt exit.

keys.name: OFFSET_GUARD
keys.causal_role: unequal guard establishes a long diagonal staff and a distinct rear-end reserve before commitment
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis low and left of chest; staff front end floats high-right while rear end hangs low-left

keys.name: REAR_HEEL_WIND
keys.causal_role: support sinks before the hands change jobs; rear end of the staff drops behind the hip
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis shifts back-left and down; front knee folds inward while staff counter-rotates without approaching target

keys.name: CROSSBODY_COIL
keys.causal_role: deep asymmetrical coil puts the staff behind the body and opens a large empty attack lane
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays rear/down while hands cross; staff becomes nearly vertical behind the rear shoulder

keys.name: ROOT_ENTRY_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: body-first authored bridge: front foot acquires ground and pelvis travels before the staff is released
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis moves five cells right/down while front tip remains behind chest; target lane is earned by support transfer

keys.name: GRIP_SLIDE_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: rear hand slides toward the center while front hand becomes the launch fulcrum; shaft accelerates without moving root as far
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis rises slightly; hands separate along shaft and front tip whips forward on a curved arc

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: distinct one-beat precontact; staff tip is visibly short of target while the body is already committed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis/chest continue forward; front tip stops one visible cell before impact while rear end still trails body

keys.name: TIP_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: explicit contact instant; pelvis changes little while front tip alone closes the final gap
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact occurs at target line without making this the farthest root position; hit-stop only implied

keys.name: PINNED_CROSSCUT
keys.causal_role: tip remains pinned while pelvis and hands move through the shaft; contact temporarily becomes a relationship axis
keys.motion_arc_root_note: front tip stays fixed; pelvis drops and advances; rear hand slides past center while rear heel peels free

keys.name: END_ROLE_BREAK
keys.causal_role: contact breaks; front tip rebounds high while rear end begins sweeping forward-low, visibly reassigning which end leads recovery
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues forward/down; front tip snaps up-rear; rear tip moves under pelvis on a delayed opposite arc

keys.name: REAR_END_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: former rear end becomes the visual leader and overshoots low-forward while the torso remains rotated past the target line
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances one more cell; rear tip sweeps beyond front knee; front tip remains high-rear creating a long counter-diagonal

keys.name: WIDE_REAR_CATCH
keys.causal_role: rear foot catches root debt before the staff is fully recovered; body stops first, tool remains displaced
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis drops back-left one cell; rear foot lands wide; staff rear tip is still low-forward and front tip still high-rear

keys.name: SHAFT_REBOUND_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: hands re-space only after support catches; staff rebounds across the chest with secondary lag instead of snapping to guard
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stabilizes; hands separate; rear end rises late and front tip drops on a soft counter-arc

keys.name: FORWARD_DEBT_EXIT
keys.causal_role: recovery ends in a different address: staff remains low-forward and pelvis remains over the front half, preserving next-action debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: no idle reset; pelvis stays three cells ahead of original guard and staff front tip settles low beyond front hand

tango.final_read: asymmetrical wind and crossbody coil; pelvis/root enters before staff commit; K5 precontact is distinct; K6 contact is explicit; K7 pins the front tip while body compresses; released staff carves into end-role reassignment; K9 overshoots; K10 catches root; K11 has secondary shaft rebound; K12 exits with forward debt rather than idle reset.

noodle_queen.final_read: TASTE/FUNCTION/CONTEMPT survive in the vertical crossbody coil, body-first entry, pinned-tip compression, visible end-role inversion, low rear-end overshoot, delayed wide catch, and non-neutral debt exit; the concept reads as a specific staff bind/recovery mechanism rather than a hammer/thrust reskin.
